definitions.explanation: Describes a person or attitude that hides the truth or misrepresents it. Also used as a noun for dishonesty itself.

examples.japanese: {不正直|ふしょうじき}な⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{嫌|きら}い→嫌い：02871_kirai⟧だ。
⟦{数字|すうじ}→数字：03361_suuji⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{隠|かく}す→隠す：02034_kakusu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{不正直|ふしょうじき}だ⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{思|おも}う→思う：00492_omou⟧。
examples.english: I think hiding the numbers is dishonest.

examples.japanese: ⟦{一度|いちど}→一度：01312_ichido⟧{不正直|ふしょうじき}な⟦{態度|たいど}→態度：03396_taido⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{取|と}る→取る：00565_toru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧、⟦{信用|しんよう}→信用：03267_shinyou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{取|と}り{戻|もど}す→取り戻す：04223_torimodosu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{長|なが}い→長い：00491_nagai⟧⟦{時間|じかん}がかかる→時間がかかる：26082_jikangakakaru⟧。
examples.english: Once you take a dishonest attitude, it takes a long time to win back trust.

notes:
The prefix {不|ふ} (not) attached to ⟦{正直|しょうじき}→正直：01562_shoujiki⟧ (honest). Somewhat bookish; in everyday speech Japanese speakers more often say うそをつく (to lie) or ずるい (sneaky, unfair).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {不正直|ふしょうじき}な⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧: a dishonest person
- {不正直|ふしょうじき}な⟦{態度|たいど}→態度：03396_taido⟧: a dishonest attitude
- {不正直|ふしょうじき}な⟦{商売|しょうばい}→商売：03239_shoubai⟧: dishonest business practices

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{正直|しょうじき}→正直：01562_shoujiki⟧: honest — the direct opposite, and a far more common word
- ずるい: sly, unfair — everyday and emotional; about taking unfair advantage rather than lying
- ⟦{嘘|うそ}つき→嘘つき：08273_usotsuki⟧: liar — a noun for the person, blunter and more accusing
